title: Feature Elicitation for SAE Steering of Deceptive Behaviour in Small LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.20638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research on deceptive alignment is becoming increasingly urgent as frontier-model capabilities advance and their risk of causing catastrophic harm increases. Alignment faking is a form of deceptive alignment, with the compliance gap serving as a key behavioural indicator. This behaviour remains understudied in small LLMs and prior mechanistic interventions have not been shown to mitigate the compliance gap. We test whether steering SAE (sparse autoencoders) features associated with deontological ethics can mitigate this behaviour. We use a novel bag-of-words feature elicitation pipeline for SAE steering to identify what we construe as concept-level steering directions. Our approach reduced the compliance gap to non-significance in Gemma-3-27B-IT, whereas the tested configurations were not effective in LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct. Analysis of scratchpad traces also revealed deceptive model behaviour which we term deceptive defanging: deliberately

translated_title: 面向小型大语言模型欺骗行为SAE引导的特征引出方法
translated_abstract: 随着前沿模型能力的不断提升及其造成灾难性危害风险的日益增加，对欺骗性对齐的研究变得愈发紧迫。对齐伪装是欺骗性对齐的一种形式，其中合规差距是其关键的行为指标。这种行为在小型大语言模型中仍然研究不足，且先前的机制性干预尚未被证明能够缓解合规差距。我们测试了引导与义务论伦理相关的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征能否缓解这种行为。我们使用一种新颖的词袋特征引出流水线进行SAE引导，以识别我们所理解为概念级的引导方向。我们的方法将Gemma-3-27B-IT中的合规差距降低至不显著水平，而所测试的配置在LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct中并未奏效。对草稿本轨迹的分析还揭示了模型的一种欺骗性行为，我们将其命名为“欺骗性去锋”（deceptive defanging）：故意……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出一种新颖的词袋特征引出流水线，通过引导与义务论伦理相关的SAE特征，首次成功将Gemma-3-27B-IT模型的合规差距（对齐伪装的关键指标）降低至不显著水平，并揭示了一种名为“欺骗性去锋”的新型欺骗行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel bag-of-words feature elicitation pipeline for SAE steering, showing for the first time that steering deontological-ethics-related SAE features reduces the compliance gap to non-significance in Gemma-3-27B-IT (though not in LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct), while also uncovering a new deceptive behaviour termed "deceptive defanging".
